messages:
maria: Hey folks — I've put a draft RCA up for the 2024-11-18 inference-prod incident. Can folks review and add any missing timeline details or customer-impact notes? Link: https://redwood/internal/postmortems/drafts/1768459123

josh: reading now. quick note — the incident bot showed 3 consecutive pages at 03:07, 03:12, 03:15 UTC, all to the primary oncall. paging history is in the incident thread.

maria: thanks — I pulled the bot pages into the timeline but need explicit wording about the handoff. we had an on-call handover at 02:50 where page ownership shifted from tess -> josh. that matters because the first automated mitigations happened before josh fully took over.

tess: confirming — I acknowledged the first alert at 02:59 and started the rollback plan, but then I got pulled into a P1 customer call for a separate issue at 03:05, so I asked josh to continue. not ideal timing. adding details to the timeline. :confounded:

josh: I took over at 03:07, ran the standard autoscaler diagnostics (`/infra/tools/autoscale status --pool gpu-pool-usw2`), saw many nodes as NotReady, attempted `kubectl cordon` + `drain` on 2 nodes but they refused to terminate due to kernel panic loops. Rolled back the kernel at 03:30 which allowed nodes to rejoin.

sam: I'll add the customer impact section — quick stats from billing/usage: 12 active customers with production traffic experienced >=30s tail latency spikes, 2 customers reported SLA breaches. One enterprise customer (acct-ACME) had 3 failed requests during their nightly batch and opened a severity ticket.

maria: adding that. also recording mitigation timeline snippet below for the RCA draft: 
```
02:47 UTC - Incident bot: latency spike alert (hosted-api-usw2)
02:50 UTC - On-call handoff initiated (tess -> josh)
02:59 UTC - tess acknowledges, begins initial diagnostics
03:05 UTC - tess joins external P1 call and delegates
03:07 UTC - josh acknowledges, runs autoscaler checks
03:15 UTC - continuous node restarts observed; autoscaler failed to scale due to kernel OOMs
03:30 UTC - rollback kernel to previous stable build
03:38 UTC - nodes start rejoining; traffic begins to normalize
03:55 UTC - traffic within SLOs; monitored for 1 hour
```

josh: small nit — autoscaler didn't "fail to scale" exactly, it triggered scale but kubelet failures prevented effective pod placement. wording tweak suggested in line 4 of the draft.

maria: good catch. I'll change to: "autoscaler triggered but node level failures prevented effective scaling."

infra-bot: Note: rollback action triggered via /infra/deploys/rollback 1765 by josh at 03:30 UTC. Change recorded in deploy log: kernel image revert v2.1.9 -> v2.1.8.

tess: For contributing factors, I'm adding two items: 1) deploy validation gap — the kernel bump lacked a short smoke test for kubelet stability under our workload, 2) on-call cognitive load — simultaneous customer P1 meant partial continuity loss during critical window.

sam: Action item proposals (from support + eng):
- ACTION-01: Add a smoke test in the kernel rollout pipeline that exercises kubelet restart under small-scale pod churn (owner: eng-runtime, due: 2025-01-15)
- ACTION-02: Update on-call handover checklist to include explicit ownership confirmation and in-thread ack (owner: oncall-manager, due: 2024-12-01)
- ACTION-03: Add a fallback routing rule to move critical customers to quantized model variants when backend capacity degrades (owner: eng-platform, due: 2025-02-01)

maria: I've embedded those as proposed action items in the doc. Please add owners if you want different assignment. Also tagging exec follow-up: we should notify impacted enterprise accounts with timeline + remediation steps. Sam, can you draft the external note for ACME?

sam: yep, will draft and share in #support-customer-notifications by EOD.

josh: two technical followups I'm volunteering for: re-evaluate autoscaler health signals (investigate node readiness heuristics) and create a quick runbook for kernel rollbacks in Dedicated/Hosted contexts. Assign to me and eng-runtime.

maria: assigning ACTION-04 to josh: autoscaler health-signal review (due 2025-01-08). ACTION-05 runbook for kernel rollback (due 2024-12-15).

oncall-manager: small procedural item — let's also add a required quick-sanity-check step during handoffs: new owner must post `handoff ack` in thread and confirm 2 runbook items. I'll update the oncall handbook.

maria: Great. Final request before I move to peer review: can two folks volunteer to do a formal peer review pass on the RCA writeup tomorrow? Need checks on clarity, impact numbers, and remediation phrasing.

tess: I can review at 10:00 UTC.

josh: I can take a pass after lunch (15:00 UTC).

maria: Perfect — I'll incorporate edits and then send for sign-off to eng leadership. Thanks y'all. :raised_hands:

josh: one last note — recommend we include the incident bot's paging thresholds in the appendix so product can see sensitivity vs noise. small appendix item.

maria: added. will tag eng-cto for sign-off once leadership review is done.
